admission.scope: Fresh diagnostics of unchanged frozen compiler used by current published RSC cohort; source fingerprint retains build-time Git identity, not current HEAD. Request samples are unscored diagnostics; cold setup and output checks excluded.

configuration.target_features_policy: explicit Config::target disables host-inferred feature flags

pmu.policy: Raw user-only hardware group on authenticated Scriptw caller or Node main TID; no inherited/background threads. Control edges included, compile/initialization/warmups/encode/exact-checks excluded. Median of process medians. Speed changes optimization AND register allocation, R unchanged.

sync.scope: Three genuine checked Flight warmups, then 100 checked literal-null windows/process. Same control protocol; not a render and not subtracted from measured rendering counts.

async.scope: Three genuine checked Flight warmups, then 100 checked literal-null windows/process. Same control protocol; not a render and not subtracted from measured rendering counts.

scriptw.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-process leaf shares, three processes/mode, 200 request windows/process. This makes exhaustive disjoint groups sum to one; process ranges retained. Not wall time or origin attribution.
scriptw.limits: Function-name classification only: compiled JS and runtime bodies include inlined allocation, value transport and guards. Collector routines exclude inline allocation. Inclusive stacks overlap and may truncate. Unknown/unavailable samples remain explicit.

sync.limits: V8 JIT map/interpreter-stack diagnostic flags active. Function-name leaves do not partition semantic origins. Native context/interceptor work is visible in this vm.Context reference. No main-isolate alternative measured.

helper_entry_counts.policy: Pinned task-bound user-only hardware execute breakpoints at same-process authenticated unique entry addresses, 100 percent event running time; control zero/disabled/direct/indirect/recursive/tail/burst cases checked. Counts overlap, do not sum. Per-hit debug traps perturb execution; no timings scored.

findings.measured: 240/250 Reflect.defineProperty entries per sync/async request; observed inclusive caller slice 3.871/3.755 percent, excluding earlier carrier construction. Overlaps other helpers and predicts no gain.
findings.experiment: Guard actual OrdinaryObject receivers and pass the validated partial descriptor to canonical ordinary definition; preserve exotic fallback. Replacing the general dispatcher inline would recurse through Proxy forwarding during Rust emission.

findings.mechanism: Ordinary Get repeats an absence/accessor lookup
findings.measured: 7823/8269 object_read entries, 10604/11187 ordinary_property_find entries and 9711/10207 ordinary_own_descriptor entries. These overlapping populations do not identify the duplicate fraction.
findings.experiment: Retain a rooted absent/data/accessor result across the ordinary branch while preserving receiver, prototype walk and exotic semantics.

findings.measured: 262/266 for_in_advance entries; compact ordinary descriptor code constructs StoredValue/PropertyDescriptor even when the observer needs only presence/enumerability. Physical allocation origins were not counted on this compiler.
findings.experiment: Use the existing observation-demand seam to return scalar facts directly; preserve live descriptors and Proxy fallback.

findings.measured: 1707/1790 ordinary_property_append and 2743/2903 function_call entries. No ordinary_property_storage_ensure entries in measured windows; this does not rule out dictionary births or setup promotions.
findings.experiment: After narrower removals, measure guarded compact appends and effect-specific internal results. No blanket value/object-model rewrite is justified by these counts.

verification.scope: Diagnostic producer/consumer qualification only. Runtime source unchanged; no new Test262 or broad semantic-suite result.

limits: All samples/counters retain the current published compiler P/R identity. Frozen build-time Git revision differs from publication HEAD; changed compiler crate files were verified unchanged.
100/200-request diagnostics have different JIT/GC history from seven-sample scored requests. Do not substitute profiled timings into charts.

Leaf categories are disjoint code locations, not removable time or allocation origins. Inlined allocation/guards/value transport are charged to their containing bodies; GC support includes allocation and reference operations as well as collection.
Selected promise/stream/codec leaves exclude source async functions, other async helpers and transitive rendering; their small own share is not total async cost.
FP callchains can truncate; inclusive caller shares overlap. Unknown IPs/symbols remain explicit. Sampling has overhead; no causal gain prediction.
No fresh physical allocation census. External encode/check work occurs between requests in the retained Realm and can influence later timed GC.
Node FP diagnostics add V8 function-map and interpreter-stack flags, separate from PMU and scored timing. Node background compiler/GC threads remain excluded.
evidence_policy: Explicit UTF-8 source, counter receipts, emitted sample text, same-process maps and protocol outputs only. Executables, libraries, package payloads, perf.data and large derived callchain rows excluded; regenerate parsed rows with archived symbolizer.
